name: irlurl-replica
description: Pixel-faithful local replica of the irl/URL agency site.

scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests server.js eslint.config.js package.json README.md ARCHITECTURE.md
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests server.js eslint.config.js package.json README.md ARCHITECTURE.md
scripts.lint: eslint server.js scripts tests src/js eslint.config.js
scripts.check: npm run build && npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:assets
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run test:browser
